subtopics.title: Advanced Dependency Injection in Spring Boot
subtopics.description: In this subtopic, we will explore advanced concepts of dependency injection in Spring Boot. We will cover advanced annotations, such as @Autowired, @Qualifier, and @Primary. Additionally, we will discuss how to use constructor injection, setter injection, and field injection. We will also examine how to work with interfaces and abstract classes in the context of dependency injection. This subtopic will help you understand how to effectively manage and inject dependencies in your Spring Boot applications, ensuring they are robust and maintainable.

subtopics.title: Spring Boot Security and Database Integration
subtopics.description: This subtopic will delve into the security features provided by Spring Boot, including how to secure your application with annotations, HTTP headers, and HTTP methods. We will also cover how to implement security for RESTful APIs. Additionally, we will explore how to integrate Spring Boot with different databases, such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. We will discuss the configuration options for each database and how to handle transactions and data persistence. This subtopic will equip you with the skills to create secure and database-integrated Spring Boot applications.
